login_identities_provider_profile_check.name: login_identities_provider_profile_check
login_identities_provider_profile_check.value: "account"."login_identities"."provider" <> 'password' OR ("account"."login_identities"."provider_email" IS NULL AND "account"."login_identities"."provider_display_name" IS NULL)

sessions_revoke_reason_check.name: sessions_revoke_reason_check
sessions_revoke_reason_check.value: revoke_reason IS NULL OR revoke_reason IN ('logout', 'logout_all', 'password_changed', 'password_reset', 'email_verified', 'member_removed', 'user_disabled', 'identity_link_reset', 'account_joined', 'account_claimed')

users_deletion_notice_check.name: users_deletion_notice_check
users_deletion_notice_check.value: "account"."users"."deletion_notice_sent_at" IS NULL OR "account"."users"."detached_at" IS NOT NULL

posts_account_scheduled_idx.name: posts_account_scheduled_idx
posts_account_scheduled_idx.where: "content"."posts"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "content"."posts"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL

posts_approved_has_schedule.name: posts_approved_has_schedule
posts_approved_has_schedule.value: "content"."posts"."status" <> 'approved' OR ("content"."posts"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "content"."posts"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "content"."posts"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

system_scoped.name: system_scoped
system_scoped.using: account_id = account.current_account_id() OR (account_id IS NULL AND account.current_account_id() IS NULL)
system_scoped.withCheck: account_id = account.current_account_id() OR (account_id IS NULL AND account.current_account_id() IS NULL)

queue_settings_retry_delays_check.name: queue_settings_retry_delays_check
queue_settings_retry_delays_check.value: cardinality("infra"."queue_settings"."retry_delays_seconds") >= 1 AND array_position("infra"."queue_settings"."retry_delays_seconds", NULL) IS NULL AND 1 <= ALL("infra"."queue_settings"."retry_delays_seconds") AND 86400 >= ALL("infra"."queue_settings"."retry_delays_seconds")
